name: Three Splendid Women
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Three Splendid Women are three ladies of the court of Camelot. The record praises all three for worth. One has hair of gold. A second is constant in her love. A third is known for her virtue. They stand as the pride of Arthur's court.

okr.objective: Set down the Three Splendid Women of Arthur's court.
key_results: Notes the gold hair of one
